description: Centered Form-B PATP S=2 under standardized asymmetric AEPD noise
regularity_rule: p_i(rho) > 1/2 for every estimated derivative moment
noise_standardisation: exact mean zero and variance one for every AEPD scenario
simulation_surface: analytic radio signal only; no real-data claim

estimators.PATP Oracle one-step: NLS start plus true AEPD moments
estimators.PATP Naive rho=0: negative plug-in baseline when derivative moments are irregular
estimators.PATP Feasible fixed: NLS residual moments at the regularity-aware oracle rho
estimators.PATP Adaptive: family-blind residual moments and two safeguarded rho updates
estimators.AEPD MLE: joint signal and mean-zero AEPD nuisance likelihood
